schemaVersion.description: Schema semantic version for farm documents.

id.description: Stable farm identifier scoped to the operator's organization.

name.description: Display name presented in navigators and reports.

assets.description: Imagery or shared geometry assets referenced by fields belonging to the farm.

id.description: Optional identifier used for provenance tracking.

type.description: Asset category used for tooling hints.

uri.description: Location of the asset (relative path, file URI, or remote URL).

notes.description: Operator notes about the asset provenance or usage.
Freeform notes shared across all fields in the farm.

createdBy.description: Actor that created the farm document (user:*, system:*).

createdAt.description: Timestamp the farm document was created (UTC).

lastModifiedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent farm-level modification.

extensions.description: Plugin-owned metadata (e.g., crop plans, profitability analyses). Keys follow <namespace>.<topic> naming.
